the risk of breast cancer among female monozygotic twins is 3.5 times greater than among dizygotic twins and that this increased risk is due to genetic factors.

the genetic component of risk of breast cancer in premenopausal women may be greater than in postmenopausal women and that the genetic component may be greater in women who had their menarche at an earlier age.

the interplay of genes, hormones, and environmental factors in the development of breast tumors.

there are no major genes involved in the development of breast and prostate cancer.
